requirements.title: Domain code must not depend on infrastructure adapters
requirements.description: Domain source files must not import internal infrastructure packages.

requirements.title: Domain code must not depend on transport concerns
requirements.description: Domain source files must not import HTTP transport packages.

requirements.title: Service configuration must declare timeout and retry limits
requirements.description: The service JSON configuration must explicitly include timeout_seconds and retry_limit as top-level keys.

requirements.title: Service timeout must remain within supported bounds
requirements.description: The service timeout must be a numeric value from 1 through 120 seconds, inclusive.

requirements.title: Application code must not invoke shells with dynamic command strings
requirements.description: Code under cmd/ and internal/ must not compose shell commands using the shell execution pattern covered by Pathfinder's reviewed OpenGrep rule.

adrs.title: Avoid dynamic evaluation of data as code

requirements.title: Application code must not dynamically evaluate untrusted JavaScript, TypeScript, or PHP input
requirements.description: Source files using JavaScript, TypeScript, or PHP must not evaluate dynamic expressions using the configured OpenGrep eval rule.

requirements.title: Python code must not dynamically evaluate input as code
requirements.description: Python source files must not call eval on potentially attacker-controlled input.

requirements.title: Ruby code must not dynamically evaluate input as code
requirements.description: Ruby source files must not call eval on potentially attacker-controlled input.

requirements.title: Java code must not use Runtime.exec with dynamically supplied commands
requirements.description: Java source files must not pass potentially untrusted strings to Runtime.getRuntime().exec.

requirements.title: C# code must review dynamic Process.Start invocation
requirements.description: C# source files must not launch processes with dynamically supplied commands unless a reviewed safe-wrapper pattern is used.

requirements.title: Bash must not use dynamic eval
requirements.description: Bash scripts must not invoke eval on potentially attacker-controlled input.

requirements.title: C must not invoke system with dynamic commands
requirements.description: C sources must not call system with dynamically composed command strings.

requirements.title: C++ must not invoke std::system with dynamic commands
requirements.description: C++ sources must not call std::system with dynamically composed command strings.

requirements.title: Rust must not launch shells with dynamic command strings
requirements.description: Rust sources must not compose shell commands via sh -c style process launches.

requirements.title: Kotlin must not use Runtime.exec with dynamic commands
requirements.description: Kotlin sources must not pass potentially untrusted strings to Runtime.exec.

requirements.title: Scala must not use Runtime.exec with dynamic commands
requirements.description: Scala sources must not pass potentially untrusted strings to Runtime.exec.

requirements.title: Elixir must not dynamically evaluate input as code
requirements.description: Elixir sources must not evaluate dynamic expressions from untrusted input.

requirements.title: Dart must not launch shell processes with dynamic arguments
requirements.description: Dart sources must not run shell processes with attacker-influenced -c style arguments.

requirements.title: Swift must not launch shells with dynamic arguments
requirements.description: Swift sources must not use shell-style process arguments from untrusted input.

requirements.title: Lua must not dynamically compile untrusted source
requirements.description: Lua sources must not compile or evaluate attacker-controlled code.

requirements.title: Visual Basic must not start processes with dynamic commands
requirements.description: VB sources must not create processes from untrusted command strings.

requirements.title: OCaml must not invoke Sys.command with dynamic strings
requirements.description: OCaml sources must not call Sys.command with dynamically composed commands.

adrs.title: Prevent OWASP injection sinks in application source

requirements.title: Python must not build SQL with f-string execute
requirements.description: Python data access must not pass f-string SQL into execute.

requirements.title: Go must not format SQL with fmt.Sprintf
requirements.description: Go data access must not build SQL via fmt.Sprintf.

requirements.title: Python must not call os.system with dynamic commands
requirements.description: Python sources must not invoke os.system on attacker-influenced input.

requirements.title: Python must not use subprocess shell=True
requirements.description: Python sources must not launch subprocesses with shell=True.

requirements.title: Node must not use child_process.exec with dynamic commands
requirements.description: JavaScript/TypeScript must not call child_process.exec with attacker-influenced commands.

requirements.title: Java must not concatenate SQL into Statement.execute
requirements.description: Java JDBC code must not concatenate untrusted input into Statement.execute.

requirements.title: Python must not pickle.loads untrusted data
requirements.description: Python sources must not deserialize untrusted payloads with pickle.loads.

requirements.title: Python must not yaml.load untrusted data unsafely
requirements.description: Python sources must not call yaml.load on untrusted input without a safe loader.

adrs.title: Prevent weak cryptography and TLS bypasses

requirements.title: Python must not use MD5 for security digests
requirements.description: Python sources must not call hashlib.md5 for security-sensitive digests.

requirements.title: Python must not use SHA1 for security digests
requirements.description: Python sources must not call hashlib.sha1 for security-sensitive digests.

requirements.title: Go must not use MD5 for security digests
requirements.description: Go sources must not call md5.New for security-sensitive digests.

requirements.title: Go must not use SHA1 for security digests
requirements.description: Go sources must not call sha1.New for security-sensitive digests.

requirements.title: Java must not use DES ciphers
requirements.description: Java sources must not request Cipher.getInstance("DES").

requirements.title: Python must not disable TLS verification
requirements.description: Python HTTP clients must not set verify=False.

requirements.title: Go must not set InsecureSkipVerify
requirements.description: Go TLS clients must not set InsecureSkipVerify: true.

requirements.title: Source must not embed AWS access key IDs
requirements.description: Repositories must not contain AKIA-form AWS access key IDs.

requirements.title: Python must not hardcode password assignments
requirements.description: Python sources must not assign long literal passwords.

requirements.title: JavaScript must not hardcode API keys
requirements.description: JavaScript/TypeScript must not embed long literal API keys.

requirements.title: Source must not embed PEM private keys
requirements.description: Repositories must not embed PEM private key material.

requirements.title: Source must not embed Slack tokens
requirements.description: Repositories must not embed Slack bot/user tokens.

requirements.title: Python must not assign AWS secret keys into environ
requirements.description: Python sources must not assign AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in os.environ.

requirements.title: Go must not Setenv AWS secret keys
requirements.description: Go sources must not os.Setenv AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.

adrs.title: Prevent AWS S3 public ACL misuse in SDK code

requirements.title: Python must not use S3 public-read ACLs
requirements.description: Python AWS SDK usage must not set ACL=public-read.

requirements.title: Python must not use S3 public-read-write ACLs
requirements.description: Python AWS SDK usage must not set ACL=public-read-write.

requirements.title: Go must not use ObjectCannedACLPublicRead
requirements.description: Go AWS SDK usage must not reference ObjectCannedACLPublicRead.

requirements.title: Code must not target IMDSv1 metadata URLs
requirements.description: Application code must not hardcode IMDSv1 metadata URLs.

requirements.title: Python requests.get sinks require review evidence
requirements.description: Python requests.get usage is flagged for SSRF review when bound to analyzer evidence.

requirements.title: Go http.Get sinks require review evidence
requirements.description: Go http.Get usage is flagged for SSRF review when bound to analyzer evidence.
